sourceSense.definition: an announcement containing information about an event
examples: you didn't give me enough notice

sourceSense.definition: the act of noticing or paying attention
examples: he escaped the notice of the police

sourceSense.definition: a request for payment

sourceSense.definition: a room where books are kept
examples: they had brandy in the library

sourceSense.definition: a collection of literary documents or records kept for reference or borrowing
a depository built to contain books and other materials for reading and study
someone employed to conduct others
someone who shows the way by leading or advising
something that offers basic information or instruction
the totality of surrounding conditions
examples: he longed for the comfortable environment of his living room

sourceSense.definition: the area in which something exists or lives
examples: the country — the flat agricultural surround

sourceSense.definition: cause to move by pulling
direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes
examples: Her good looks attract the stares of many men

sourceSense.definition: move into a certain direction
examples: the car pulls to the right

sourceSense.definition: a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour

a particular point in time

sourceSense.definition: in accordance with fixed order or procedure or principle

sourceSense.definition: often used as intensifiers
conforming to a standard or pattern

sourceSense.definition: the inside lower horizontal surface (as of a room, hallway, tent, or other structure)

we spread our sleeping bags on the dry floor of the tent

sourceSense.definition: a structure consisting of a room or set of rooms at a single position along a vertical scale
examples: what level is the office on?

sourceSense.definition: a lower limit

sourceSense.definition: buildings for carrying on industrial labor

widely known and esteemed
actively or fully engaged or occupied
overcrowded or cluttered with detail
intrusive in a meddling or offensive manner

sourceSense.definition: very good; of the highest quality

sourceSense.definition: a device designed to prevent injury or accidents
clothing in general

he always bought his clothes at the same store

sourceSense.definition: an unfortunate mishap; especially one causing damage or injury
anything that happens suddenly or by chance without an apparent cause

the pregnancy was a stroke of bad luck

sourceSense.definition: a course of conduct

sourceSense.definition: a way especially designed for a particular use
an established line of travel or access
belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire

sourceSense.definition: very old
the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit

sourceSense.definition: the act of using

sourceSense.definition: systematic training by multiple repetitions
a white crystalline carbohydrate used as a sweetener and preservative

informal terms for money
being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird

sourceSense.definition: not known before

don't let anyone unknown into the house

sourceSense.definition: relating to or originating in or characteristic of another place or part of the world

sourceSense.definition: being directly across from each other; facing

sourceSense.definition: of leaves etc.; growing in pairs on either side of a stem
moving or facing away from each other
well known or easily recognized

a day like any other filled with familiar duties and experiences

sourceSense.definition: (usually followed by ‘with’) well informed about or knowing thoroughly
examples: he was familiar with those roads

sourceSense.definition: of the greatest possible degree or extent or intensity

sourceSense.definition: (criminal law) a final judgment of guilty in a criminal case and the punishment that is imposed

sourceSense.definition: the ripened reproductive body of a seed plant
an amount of a product

sourceSense.definition: (of a standing person) the distance from head to foot

sourceSense.definition: the air that is inhaled and exhaled in respiration
a short respite

sourceSense.definition: a business relation in which two parties compete to gain customers

sourceSense.definition: form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case

sourceSense.definition: give a certain impression of being something or having a certain aspect

sourceSense.definition: come into sight or view

sourceSense.definition: move with force

sourceSense.definition: press, drive, or impel (someone) to action or completion of an action

sourceSense.definition: make publicity for; try to sell (a product)

sourceSense.definition: cause to decide

sourceSense.definition: drop a hint; intimate by a hint

sourceSense.definition: give a description of

a communication system based on broadcasting electromagnetic waves
